symft-1t.settings: post on: compile_counts_sampler(postselect_detectors=True, cpu_backend='compiled'); post off: compile_sampler(batch=True) measurement records + stim m2d

output_contract.on: compile_counts_sampler(cpu_backend='compiled' if eligible): counts only (accepted shots, observable-0 logical errors)

notes.shots_per_s: attempted shots per second, kept or not
notes.kept: fraction of attempted shots surviving postselection
notes.rates: detection_rate: mean over kept shots and noiselessly-deterministic detectors of a detection event; observable_rate: mean observable flip among kept shots (null where the simulator returns no per-shot rows; Tsim's rates come from a separate Tsim CPU reference run)
notes.suspect: a sanity statistic (kept, rates) differs from the Tsim reference (or xtim/Magna where Tsim cannot run) by > 5 standard errors; null = nothing comparable
notes.timing: Tsim: tsim-dev bench, pinned tsim-bench 19804f26 worker (calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB returned, median of 3 fresh-process rounds). Others: n doubles from 64 until a call takes >= 2 s (or 2 GiB output), best of 3 calls at that n. compile_s and warmup_s are excluded from shots_per_s. 300 s per cell, systemd MemoryMax per worker
notes.isolation: every timed cell ran alone (1t pinned to one physical core, mt to the 12 physical cores); only failed 1t cells (timeout/OOM/unsupported) come from an 8-way parallel pass
notes.details: results_full.json has standard errors, z-scores, output contracts per cell, raw errors
notes.tsim_remeasured: results_v2: every Tsim cell (tsim-cpu-1t, tsim-cpu-mt, tsim-cuda; post on and off) was re-measured on 2026-11-20 with tsim-dev's pinned tsim-bench corpus 19804f26 (no --corpus-dir; same Tsim checkouts src/tsim-dm @ 0e95b9a3 and src/tsim-cuda @ d140f3d9, same flags). The first run passed --corpus-dir /home/rafaelha/quera/tsim-active-width, so tsim-dev used that checkout's tsim-bench main@9bc81ad worker, which capped a call at 2^28 / (detectors + observables) shots as if rows were unpacked booleans; for fast circuits with many detectors the calls were too small and per-call overhead lowered shots/s (e.g. end2end_d5_dsurface15 on tsim-cuda: 439M -> 1.79G shots/s). tsim-bench 19804f26 ('bound a call by the bytes it returns') bounds a call by ~256 MB of returned bit-packed kept rows (<= 2^27 shots). The pinned corpus's .stim files are byte-identical (sha256) to the 9bc81ad ones and the postselection masks are identical for all 13 circuits. Not re-measured (old cells kept): code_switching_bt81 (all Tsim configs, refused K=63), code_switching_bt27 on tsim-cuda (K=26 > 11) and on CPU (0.23 shots/s; the cap cannot bind). Non-Tsim cells are unchanged from results.json. Most Tsim cells got faster (tsim-cuda up to 4.1x); one got slower: end2end_d5_dsurface15 tsim-cpu-mt post-off 2.58M -> 1.44M (re-checked twice: 1.44M, 1.40M), because the old cap made 6 calls of 97,790 shots (2^28 / 2745 outputs) per round and the new bound allows one ~660k-shot call (~0.45 s, ~230 MB), which is slower per shot on 12 threads.
